svg.title: System components
svg.desc: Principal package dependencies. cmd/server wires configuration, graph, provider and telemetry, then selects the HTTP server or MCP stdio boundary. internal/server registers internal/api and creates the shared reasoning service; its rate limiter uses memory or Redis. HTTP handlers use the idempotency package for JSON replay, call internal/service and read internal/graph through the dependency routed around the lower row. MCP calls the same service and reads internal/graph. The reasoning service reads the graph and records metrics. internal/llm implements the Planner interface, configures the provider registry and calls the generated BAML client, which calls the configured provider with Amazon Bedrock as the default. The direct internal/server to internal/metrics and cmd/server to internal/llm imports are omitted to keep dependency arrows from crossing. Shared configuration, telemetry and domain types appear as bands instead of repeated import arrows; telemetry optionally exports OTLP and LangSmith traces.

g.aria-label: internal/telemetry: shared HTTP, MCP, reasoning and provider spans
internal/domain: shared request, response and graph types
